_meta.description: Design-system-scored eval: given a component need and a project's own component library, does the scorer find the right existing component, or correctly say nothing fits? Gold is AUTHORED BY CLAUDE from reading component filenames/exports, NOT independently verified by a human -- treat as a first-pass label set. Needs are phrased functionally (no component names). 'gold' lists acceptable files; empty gold = nothing in the library should match.

buzz.note: shadcn-style primitives (many use `export { A, B }`) plus app-specific widgets
